title: Unit Types

help.title: About Unit Types
help.overview: A Unit type is the catalogue type every unit must pick (apartment, office, parking, and so on). Categories organise types. Creating a type does not create units — units pick a type when you add inventory.

sections.title: What a unit type holds
items: Name and category (required). Create the category first.
Optional group (a free-text bucket inside the category), description, and icon token.
Private flag — a catalogue marker on the type card. It is not occupancy and does not change unit status.
Slug is generated from the company name plus the type name. You do not type it.

sections.title: On this page
items: Delete is a soft delete, but it is blocked while any unit uses this type or any edifice lists it as a property type.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Every unit has exactly one unit type. Price, areas, and availability live on the unit, not here.
Edifices can also list property types they offer. That list is independent of which units already exist.
Renaming a type updates labels. It does not rewrite listed prices on existing units.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Create unit type categories if they are missing.
Create the types you sell or rent.
When adding units, pick the matching type.
